chunks: In the story of Joseph and his brothers are lessons for those who inquire.
ai.seo_question: What lessons can be learned from the story of Joseph and his brothers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate that the story of Yusuf (AS) is not merely historical narrative but a comprehensive model of patience (sabr) and divine providence (tawfiq) for the seeker of truth. The phrase 'for those who ask' (lil-sa'ileen) implies an active, intellectual engagement with the text, reflecting the Shia emphasis on deriving legal and spiritual lessons from the detailed accounts of the Prophets.
